_about: Issue catalogue shown in the Lab's Open issues panel (CONTRACTS 9.5). Maintained by Claude alongside plans/v26.2.md; the user's close/reopen/comments live in LAB_DIR/issues-state.json. Keep ids stable.

items.title: DA2 depth squashes range beyond ~12 m
details: depth/ground 0.64 at 20–30 m, 0.39 at 30–60 m; sky ~12 m.
Distant buildings land at 6–12 m and make false wall faces.

items.title: Face/edge test: precision 0.82, recall 0.73 at ≤ 10 steps
details: Walls beside the path still give some calls: #137 at 26.33 s pushes back the ✗ 28.50 "person at 12:15 in 6".
The low sea wall is missed.

items.title: Chest-0004's 10.9 s building is said late (~12.3 s)
details: With the default `depth` it is said at ~12.3 s; only ground+depth says it at 10.83 s.

items.title: ✓ 150.50 "building at 12:45 in 3" is said earlier
details: Said at 144.33 instead, and the repeat is suppressed.

items.title: Ground modes lose ~12 ✓ against depth
details: ground-contact / ground+depth lose ~12 ✓, mostly at step thresholds tuned on raw depth.

items.title: Snap and coasting side effects
details: A pole in front of a facade can be pulled to a nearer wall corner.
Coasting can announce a returning vehicle one frame early.

items.title: World map: stale wall votes where nothing is seen (v26.2.5)
details: Cells the current frame neither sees as ground nor covers with a face ray keep old wall votes until they decay (Chest-0004 120 s: a wedge behind the hand).

items.title: World map: clearing may remove some real wall (v26.2.5)
details: At 105 s barrier-wall cells dropped 512 → 194; most were the stale cloud, not checked cell by cell.
Far false faces from the depth squash (O1) are now drawn as clearer lines.

items.title: World map: small objects missing from the object layer (v26.2.6)
details: Chest-0004 0 s: the sidewalk-obstacle item at 1.6 m ahead / 0.6 m right has no object cells on the map (empty / sidewalk there).
Since v26.2.6 a click on its marker reads it, but the map cells and the collision rules that read the map still miss it.

items.title: Speech: role side limits tuned on the old pinhole lateral (v26.2.7)
details: Item side positions now go through the fisheye lens; the side limits in metres (context 2.5, proximity 2.6, people 2.75, thin notice 2.5, beeps 0.9) were tuned on the old, too-wide values.

Fixture ticks reproduced 47 → 39; review 6 132.34 / 179.5 said again, 180.3 proximity sound; review 8 27.3 s 'person standing at 11:30 in 8'; review 4 384.0 dropped. A uniform rescale only reaches 41: needs a per-rule retune. `distance.itemLens: off` = old behaviour for A/B.

items.title: World map: buildings said nearer at their ground contact (v26.2.7)
details: Facades sit where the sidewalk ends, ~1 m nearer than depth read them (review 7 13.0 s 'building at 12:15 in 5', was 'at 12 in 8').
Wall-base depth / ground reaches 1.7 at 105 s and 1.3 at 120 s on Chest-0004: which one is right is not verified.

items.title: World map: some sidewalk still behind buildings (v26.2.7)
details: Thin one- or two-cell building slivers inside open sidewalk early in a run; real sidewalk under bridges.
Unseen areas deeper than 0.5 m between ground and a building stay unknown on purpose (only seams are closed).

items.title: World map: road ahead at 10 s and 20 s — not a geometry bug (v26.2.10, checked v26.2.11)
details: v26.2.11: with depth surfaces the observation is within ~0.3-0.5 m of the image; at 20 s the road edge is 0.5-0.7 m left of the centre line (the sidewalk narrows at a tree) and touches the corridor.
The image horizon was wrong there (below the distant cars' ground contact); sensor runs now use the gravity horizon. Tell us a time if you still see road ahead on a v26.2.11 run.

items.title: World map: pose alignment corrects only the drift the map can see (v26.2.10)
details: Unverified after real turns. Chest-0004's dead-reckoned heading drifts ~0.8 deg/s (+80 deg at 100 s walking straight); the accumulated correction reaches -178 deg by 450 s, so the heading is far off.
The collision pass's own world memory (_WorldMemory) is not corrected, only the map's pose.

Closed 2026-11-04 (v26.2.11): heading from the GoPro gyro (GPS course MAD 14 deg vs 71 with the flow heading on Chest-0004, 2 vs 6 on Chest-0002), and the collision pass uses the map's corrected pose (ego.onePose).

items.title: People split: the depth-jump cut is skipped for relative depth (v26.2.10)
details: With relative (unscaled) depth the 0.6 m jump between columns cannot be judged, so only the height-profile cuts split a blob.

items.title: People split: some over-splits (v26.2.10)
details: Chest-0004: hand + cane at 127 s, a speck beside a woman at 234 s, some far pairs at 65 s become extra person items.

items.title: Only the *_v26210 tests see the shipped v26.2.10 behaviour
details: Older tests run on v26.2.9 map settings (time decay, gap closing, no person split) pinned in conftest; their goldens are re-pinned to those.

items.title: Step length prior too short: spoken steps ~12 % high without good GPS (v26.2.11)
details: GPS on 5 good clips: your step is 0.81-0.85 m; the prior is 0.415 x 1.78 = 0.739 m. Runs with good GPS are corrected (ego.gps.speedScale).
Raise body.stepLengthRatio to ~0.47? Your call.
v26.2.12: GPS step length (median GPS speed / cadence, 0.82-0.85 m on good-GPS clips) when a run has >= 60 s of good moving GPS, else the prior; a typed step length still wins.
items.reason: The user: "always go with sensors when they are available, so gps."

items.title: Predictive speech drops passed items and changes the numbers (v26.2.11)
details: Chest-0004: 90 -> 64 phrases (items passed before their mention ends); exact tick matches on the fixtures 18 -> 2 because your ticks pin the old numbers.
wordsPerSecond 2.8 uncalibrated; turns during the phrase are ignored. A/B: re-run with Predictive speech off.
v26.2.12: advance capped at 1.5 m, clock swing held, measured closing speed (review 9 23.51 s over-advanced ~2 m).

items.title: Map collision source adds beeps for poles / signs beside the path (v26.2.11, not default)
details: Fixtures +26 beeps, Chest-0004 263 vs 215. Map-only statics and track-only movers reach speech only via ghost / coast; 'nearer distance wins' not done.
v26.2.12: map is the default source (the user: "make c2 config the default"); thin items speak only inside the lane; co-located items use the closest.

items.title: World tracks: re-acquisition error 0.68 m (target 0.6); missing share 16 % (v26.2.11)
details: Static speed is fixed (0.06 m/s median). Missing share and image tracks per world track rose with the 1 s hold and re-id; depth-scale uncertainty not modelled.

items.title: Gravity horizon is the default on sensor runs; roll correction off (v26.2.11)
details: Speech differs from the image horizon (Chest-0004 98 vs 92 phrases). Roll correction sign unverified.

items.title: Heading unchecked where there is no GPS (v26.2.11)
details: Chest-0004 400-454 s: gyro -330 deg vs flow -175 deg. One gyro-to-video offset (-0.10 s) for all clips. 4K clips (Chest-0001/0007, Head-0002) have no GPS.

items.title: Heading switch changed speech, unreviewed (v26.2.11)
details: Chest-0004 90 / 167 (flow) -> 94 / 217 (imu) speech / beeps, mostly ~30 more building beeps.

items.title: Thin items outside the lane are no longer spoken (v26.2.12)
details: speech.zoneOnly removes notices for poles / signs / obstacles beside the path (review 9, 1.17 s). Older fixture reviews had ticked 7 of them.

items.title: "Blocked ahead" did not fire where review 9 asked (21.17 s) (v26.2.12)
details: The map shows the scaffold fence only on the right (13 of 286 lane cells solid within 3 m), below the 70 % width rule. It fires 7 times on other fixtures, unreviewed.

v26.2.12 follow-up: obstacles on the walkway (the skip at ~6 m) count from 6.5 m with the bases of the last 0.7 s; the free direction is the smallest turn past them. Review 9 now says "sidewalk blocked at 11:45, continues 12:15" at 20.67 s.
items.reason: The user: "correct it on current version since its part of previous request"; fixed in the v26.2.12 follow-up, waiting for the user's check on the new run.

items.title: "Blocked" for obstacles fires on low walls and bollards, unreviewed (v26.2.12 follow-up)
details: Most new firings on Chest-0002 come from barrier wall: the low sea wall at the end of crossings and along the promenade ("crosswalk/sidewalk blocked at 12"), and posts near the fitness bars at 286-297 s. One phrase per blockage (clearS 2 s) removed the repeats; fixture firings 7 -> ~30, all unreviewed.

items.title: Lane follows the camera axis, not the walking direction (v26.2.12)
details: Review 9 18.34 s: a tree trunk at the curb ~1.5 m left read as in the lane (thin-trunk depth 0.7-1.2 m for ~5 m). Silenced only by the distance-jump rule; a lane along the walking direction needs the focus of expansion (not stored in motion.npz).

items.title: Predictive measured speed can under-advance (v26.2.12)
details: The advance uses the depth closing rate, which reads low against the cadence speed (0.72-1.0 vs 1.29 m/s at Chest-0004 23.5 s).

items.title: Review 9: two numbers moved, one ✓ beep merged (v26.2.12)
details: 11.66 s 'building at 12:45 in 2' -> '12:30 in 3'; 22.84 s beep 'pole at 12 5->3' -> '11:45 5->2'; the 25.29 s ✓ beep merged into the 22.84 s pole episode.

items.title: GPS step length low on Head-0010 / Head-0011 (v26.2.12)
details: 0.70 m with p10 ~0.4: stop-and-go or cadence errors, unverified. Chest-0004 / 0005 have < 60 s of good GPS and keep the prior.

items.title: Beeps near people
details: A person within 5 steps with unknown motion beeps, even 2–3 steps beside the path (`unknownMotionBeepSteps`, `movingLaneHalfWidthM`; v26.1.12).
A receding person we catch up on gets no beeps; you ticked those at 43.2 s.

items.title: Finals: rule 6 vs rule 9b
details: Finals for named things come back (rule 6), while finals for never-named context things inside a danger run go silent (rule 9b). The two pull in opposite directions (v26.1.16).

items.title: Vehicles: the 2.0 m/s own-speed level
details: It drops 7 unreviewed "vehicle approaching" phrases on the full run (v26.1.16).

items.title: Reach at the start: people at 13 steps
details: People 13 steps away in the first 1.8 s are not said, because of the 10-step reach (v26.1.15).

items.title: Camera side windows
details: Portrait left/right windows see no walking surface, because the seed box is straight ahead. A "faces forward" mode is the alternative.
Landscape left/right equal center (v26.1.15 follow-up).

items.title: Head-mounted footage untested
details: `Head-center-0001…0011` were never tested with the head calibration.
The crosswalk tones were not mined on head footage.
The IMU body heading hook (`_walking_axis_offset_m`) is unused.

items.title: Ego motion
details: The walking speed (cadence × step) reads 1.4–1.8× fast; the cadence harmonic is suspected.
Turning in place reads as walking (302.8 s).

items.title: Mover depth
details: Mover closing speeds use raw (uncorrected) depth.
Lateral rate does not separate moving from static (re-try with depth).

items.title: World map
details: Minutes-long drift is untested.
Ghost beeps have never fired on real footage and are untuned.
There is no Chest-0002 map run; it was skipped while the GPU trained, and the GPU is free now.

items.title: Portrait windows
details: Items cut by the window edge are not flagged as clipped.
Depth runs on the window crop.

items.title: Roadmap steps 3–5
details: Traversability, then 2.5D, then the learned layer.

items.title: Apple port
details: Only after the Lab logic matures (user, 2026-10-17). The mobile depth model path also belongs here.

items.title: HackEye-Models curation and retrain
details: Curate frames with the X model, then retrain the app model (720p/l is the candidate).

items.title: Device calibration profiles
details: Per device + lens mode + mount: lens intrinsics (checkerboard clip), mount height/tilt, raw-depth → metres correction curve (chalk marks 2–20 m).
Gives a correct scale from frame 0 and attacks the far-depth squash (O1); per-frame scale still refines on top.
Apple app: ARKit motion tracking gives metric scale per frame (no LiDAR needed).

items.title: The 10.9 s building
details: Now handled by the map; the timing is tracked under O3.

items.title: Walls/fences as lane dangers
details: Covered by the v26.2.2 face/edge test.

items.title: Sound parameters by ear and "kerb"
details: You tune these with the v26.1.16 sound tuner.

items.title: Chrome macOS speech fix
details: Unconfirmed, but no reports since.
